```{r}
# 加载必要的包
library(tidyverse)

# 设置数据路径（根据实际情况修改）
data_path <- "D:/Users/lenovo/Desktop/Prediction of anticancer drug resistance/dataset/CCLE/"

## 1. 读取基因表达数据（已经log2(TPM+1)转换后的数据）
expression_data <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1.csv"), 
                           header = TRUE, 
                           check.names = FALSE)

# 设置行名为细胞系ID，转换为矩阵
rownames(expression_data) <- expression_data[,1]
expression_matrix <- as.matrix(expression_data[,-1])

cat("表达数据维度:", dim(expression_matrix), "\n")
cat("示例数据 - 前3个细胞系，前5个基因:\n")
print(expression_matrix[1:3, 1:5])

## 2. 读取拷贝数变异数据
cnv_data <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "PortalOmicsCNGeneLog2.csv"), 
                    header = TRUE, 
                    check.names = FALSE)

# 设置行名为细胞系ID，转换为矩阵
rownames(cnv_data) <- cnv_data[,1]
cnv_matrix <- as.matrix(cnv_data[,-1])

# 应用log2转换（如果数据还未转换）
# 注意：根据数据描述，CNV数据应该已经是log2转换过的比值
# 如果数据已经是转换后的，跳过这步；如果是原始比值，需要转换
# cnv_matrix <- log2(cnv_matrix + 1)

cat("CNV数据维度:", dim(cnv_matrix), "\n")

## 3. 读取基因突变数据
mutation_data <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "OmicsSomaticMutationsMatrixDamaging.csv"), 
                         header = TRUE, 
                         check.names = FALSE)

# 设置行名为细胞系ID
rownames(mutation_data) <- mutation_data[,1]
mutation_matrix <- as.matrix(mutation_data[,-1])

cat("突变数据维度:", dim(mutation_matrix), "\n")
cat("突变数据取值范围:", unique(as.vector(mutation_matrix)), "\n")

## 4. 数据质量控制和基本信息
check_data_summary <- function(data, name) {
  cat("\n====", name, "数据概览 ====\n")
  cat("细胞系数:", nrow(data), "\n")
  cat("基因数:", ncol(data), "\n")
  cat("数据范围:", round(range(data, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
  cat("缺失值数量:", sum(is.na(data)), "\n")
  cat("数据格式:", class(data), "\n")
}

check_data_summary(expression_matrix, "基因表达")
check_data_summary(cnv_matrix, "拷贝数变异")
check_data_summary(mutation_matrix, "基因突变")

## 5. 数据整合 - 寻找共同的细胞系和基因
# 获取共同细胞系
common_cell_lines <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(expression_matrix),
  rownames(cnv_matrix),
  rownames(mutation_matrix)
))

cat("\n共同细胞系数:", length(common_cell_lines), "\n")

# 获取共同基因
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  colnames(expression_matrix),
  colnames(cnv_matrix), 
  colnames(mutation_matrix)
))

cat("共同基因数:", length(common_genes), "\n")

## 6. 创建整合的数据集
# 根据共同细胞系和基因筛选数据
expression_integrated <- expression_matrix[common_cell_lines, common_genes]
cnv_integrated <- cnv_matrix[common_cell_lines, common_genes]
mutation_integrated <- mutation_matrix[common_cell_lines, common_genes]

cat("\n整合后数据维度:\n")
cat("表达数据:", dim(expression_integrated), "\n")
cat("CNV数据:", dim(cnv_integrated), "\n")
cat("突变数据:", dim(mutation_integrated), "\n")

## 7. 读取KEGG基因集数据
read_gmt_file <- function(file_path) {
  lines <- readLines(file_path)
  genesets <- list()
  
  for (line in lines) {
    elements <- str_split(line, "\t")[[1]]
    if (length(elements) >= 3) {
      pathway_name <- elements[1]
      genes <- elements[3:length(elements)]
      genes <- genes[genes != ""]  # 移除空值
      genesets[[pathway_name]] <- genes
    }
  }
  return(genesets)
}

# 读取KEGG基因集
data_path1 <- "D:/Users/lenovo/Desktop/Prediction of anticancer drug resistance/dataset/GSEA/"

kegg_genesets <- read_gmt_file(paste0(data_path1, "c2.cp.kegg_medicus.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"))
cat("\n成功读取", length(kegg_genesets), "个KEGG通路基因集\n")

# 检查基因集与我们的数据的重叠情况
kegg_genes_all <- unique(unlist(kegg_genesets))
overlap_genes <- intersect(common_genes, kegg_genes_all)
cat("KEGG基因集与数据重叠基因数:", length(overlap_genes), "\n")

## 8. 保存处理后的数据
saveRDS(expression_integrated, paste0(data_path, "processed_expression.rds"))
saveRDS(cnv_integrated, paste0(data_path, "processed_cnv.rds"))
saveRDS(mutation_integrated, paste0(data_path, "processed_mutation.rds"))
saveRDS(kegg_genesets, paste0(data_path, "kegg_genesets.rds"))

# 保存数据概览
processing_summary <- list(
  common_cell_lines = common_cell_lines,
  common_genes = common_genes,
  expression_dim = dim(expression_integrated),
  cnv_dim = dim(cnv_integrated),
  mutation_dim = dim(mutation_integrated),
  kegg_pathways_count = length(kegg_genesets),
  gene_overlap = length(overlap_genes)
)

saveRDS(processing_summary, paste0(data_path, "processing_summary.rds"))

cat("\n=== 数据处理完成 ===\n")
cat("输出文件:\n")
cat("- processed_expression.rds: 整合后的表达数据\n")
cat("- processed_cnv.rds: 整合后的CNV数据\n")
cat("- processed_mutation.rds: 整合后的突变数据\n")
cat("- kegg_genesets.rds: KEGG基因集\n")
cat("- processing_summary.rds: 处理摘要\n")
```
```{r}
# 数据分布可视化
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# 表达数据分布
expression_df <- as.data.frame(expression_integrated) %>%
  melt(variable.name = "Gene", value.name = "Expression")

ggplot(expression_df, aes(x = Expression)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of gene expression data", x = "log2(TPM+1)", y = "frequency") +
  theme_minimal()

# 突变数据统计
mutation_stats <- data.frame(
  CellLine = rownames(mutation_integrated),
  TotalMutations = rowSums(mutation_integrated > 0)
)

ggplot(mutation_stats, aes(x = TotalMutations)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "The distribution of mutation numbers in each cell line", x = "mut_num", y = "Cell line_num") +
  theme_minimal()

# 保存可视化结果
ggsave("expression_distribution.png", width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("mutation_distribution.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r}

# 安装并加载必要的包
if (!require("dplyr")) install.packages("dplyr")
if (!require("readr")) install.packages("readr")
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

gmt_to_csv <- function(gmt_file, csv_file) {
  # 读取GMT文件
  lines <- readLines(gmt_file)
  
  # 解析GMT格式
  result <- lapply(lines, function(line) {
    parts <- strsplit(line, "\t")[[1]]
    data.frame(
      GeneSet = parts[1],
      Description = parts[2],
      Gene = if(length(parts) > 2) parts[3:length(parts)] else NA
    )
  })
  
  # 合并并保存
  final_df <- do.call(rbind, result)
  write_csv(final_df, csv_file)
}

# 使用示例
gmt_to_csv("dataset/GSEA/c2.cp.kegg_legacy.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.gmt", "c2.cp.kegg_legacy.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.csv")










cat("当前工作目录:", getwd(), "\n")

# 2. 查找GMT文件
gmt_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.gmt$", recursive = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
cat("找到的GMT文件:\n")
print(gmt_files)

# 3. 如果找到文件，使用完整路径
if(length(gmt_files) > 0) {
  full_path <- normalizePath(gmt_files[1])
  cat("使用文件:", full_path, "\n")
  gmt_to_csv(full_path, "output.csv")
} else {
  cat("没有找到GMT文件，请检查文件位置\n")
}
```
